dct_description_sm:
Includes data required to create York Region Official Plan - 2010 Map 13: Significant Groundwater Recharge Areas. Significant groundwater recharge areas and Oak Ridges Moraine Plan Area were used for this map.

The data layers do not take the place of a legal survey or other primary source documentation and may not be used to determine, certify, or verify if a parcel is a qualifying or exempt property.
